correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of the published infectious equation at the fully susceptible disease-free state gives i'=[beta(t)-(gamma+mu)]i because each recovered reinfection term R_k I is quadratic. Integrating this scalar equation over one sinusoidal period gives the exact multiplier exp(T[beta0/2-(gamma+mu)]) and threshold beta0=2(gamma+mu). The standalone checker reproduces the source-specific numerical threshold and susceptibility-average factors. The claim is explicitly limited to local invasion and does not infer global dynamics from the linear calculation.

value.rationale: Eq. (19) is used by the motivating paper to interpret fitted influenza transmission in terms of a basic reproduction number. The correction removes a dependence on recovered-stage susceptibilities that are absent at disease-free invasion and supplies an exact threshold directly tied to the model's seasonal forcing. This is a substantive epidemiological interpretation issue, not a cosmetic notation change, while the claim remains narrow enough not to question the calibrated trajectories themselves.
